فِرْصَادٌ The [mulberry called] تُوت [q. v.]: (AO, AHn, O, Msb:) or the [tree called] تُوت: or its fruit: (M, K:) or the red توت: (S, Msb:) [or, accord. to Zeyn el-'Attár, the sweet and white mulberry: so says Golius: see تُوتٌ:] Lth says that it is a well-known tree; that the people of ElBasrah call the tree thus, and call its fruit تُوتٌ: (T, O, * Msb:) and by فِرْصَادٌ the lawyers mean the tree that bears the [fruit called] تُوت. (Msb.) ―
-b2- Also A red dye; (K:) or redness. (M, L.) ―
-b3- See also فِرْصِدٌ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
